build_mobilenetv3_small_backbone: build a MobileNetV3 small architecture backbone for semantic segmentation with default out indices
build_mobilenetv3_large_backbone: build a MobileNetV3 large architecture backbone with batch normalization and custom output indices
run_mobilenetv3_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MobileNetV3 backbone and collect feature maps from specified layers
freeze_mobilenetv3_stages: freeze the first N stages of the MobileNetV3 backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
review_mobilenetv3_arch_settings: review the MobileNetV3 architecture settings for small and large variants including kernel size and channels
